entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To ensure quality service, this call may be recorded. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. You're speaking with David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. A helmet. I'm just so confused by the website and the policies, I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
Oh, uhm, let me see... It's VF90125. I just... I don't know if I can return it. It's been a little while.

Thank you, one moment. Okay, I see the order for the AeroSafe Helmet, delivered on November 5th, which was 34 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference, I guess? The color... it just doesn't look the same as it did online. I was expecting a brighter red. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out.
I understand, sometimes the lighting in photos can make a color appear slightly different. I'm just pulling up our policy information for you now.
Okay. I just really want to be sure I have the right gear. You know, safety is so important, and if I don't love it, I won't wear it. Can't you just help me?
Absolutely. Your safety is our top priority, and I can definitely help. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window for standard items like this helmet.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not a problem at all. I have initiated the return for you, and I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be processed.
Thank you so much, David. You've made this so easy.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
